name: useADPFHintSession
summary: PerformanceHintManager hint session: report how long work took against a target duration for the session's threads.
plain: Creates an ADPF performance hint session. You report how long a unit of work took against a target duration and the platform may use that when scheduling the session's threads. Whether and how it changes CPU frequency is up to the platform and is not observed by this hook.
description: Uses android.os.PerformanceHintManager (Android 12+, API 31+). On mount the native module closes any previous session, then calls createHintSession for the app's main thread (its tid equals the process id), or for the thread ids passed as threadIds, with the initial target duration. isSupported is true only when createHintSession returned a session; otherwise it is false and error says so. reportWorkDuration and updateTargetWorkDuration forward to Session.reportActualWorkDuration and Session.updateTargetWorkDuration and return true when the platform accepted the call. The session covers the main thread by default, so report durations of work done on that thread (or pass the tids of the threads that do the work); durations measured on the JS thread describe a thread that is not in the session. The native module keeps one session per app.

params.name: initialTargetDurationMs
params.desc: Initial target work duration in milliseconds, defaulting to 16.67ms (a 60 FPS budget).

params.name: threadIds
params.desc: Thread ids (Linux tids) the session covers. Defaults to the app's main thread.

returns.name: targetFrameDurationMs
returns.desc: Current target work duration in milliseconds, as last set by this hook.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if hint session creation or reporting failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Data provenance: 'hardware' when a session exists, 'unavailable' otherwise.

returns.name: reportWorkDuration
returns.desc: Reports the time the session's threads took for one unit of work, in nanoseconds. True when the platform accepted the call.

returns.name: updateTargetWorkDuration
returns.desc: Updates the target work duration in nanoseconds (for example when the refresh rate changes). True when the platform accepted the call.

returns.name: closeSession
returns.desc: Closes the active ADPF hint session. True when the platform closed it; isSupported is unchanged.

actions.name: reportWorkDuration(actualDurationNanos)
actions.desc: Reports one unit of work duration for the session's threads. Returns false when there is no session or the platform rejected the call.

actions.name: updateTargetWorkDuration(targetNanos)
actions.desc: Updates the target work duration in nanoseconds. Returns false when there is no session or the platform rejected the call.

actions.name: closeSession()
actions.desc: Closes the active ADPF hint session. Returns false when there is none.

agentNote: Available on Android 12+ (API 31+). The hook reports durations to the platform; it does not observe or guarantee any change in CPU frequency.
